def partitie(L, st, dr):
    pivot = L[dr]
    i = st
    for j in range(st, dr):
        if L[j] < pivot:
            L[i], L[j] = L[j], L[i]
            i += 1
    L[i], L[dr] = L[dr], L[i]
    return i

def quicksort_inplace(L, st, dr):
    if st < dr:
        p = partitie(L, st, dr)
        quicksort_inplace(L, st, p - 1)
        quicksort_inplace(L, p + 1, dr)

L = [9, 3, 8, 1, 5, 2]
quicksort_inplace(L, 0, len(L) - 1)
print(L)

def flood_fill(grila, i, j, veche, noua):
    if i < 0 or i >= len(grila) or j < 0 or j >= len(grila[0]):
        return
    if grila[i][j] != veche:
        return
    grila[i][j] = noua
    flood_fill(grila, i + 1, j, veche, noua)
    flood_fill(grila, i - 1, j, veche, noua)
    flood_fill(grila, i, j + 1, veche, noua)
    flood_fill(grila, i, j - 1, veche, noua)

def dist(a, b):
    return sum((x - y) ** 2 for x, y in zip(a, b)) ** 0.5

def kmeans(puncte, centroizi, pasi=10):
    for _ in range(pasi):
        grupuri = [[] for _ in centroizi]
        for p in puncte:
            k = min(range(len(centroizi)), key=lambda i: dist(p, centroizi[i]))
            grupuri[k].append(p)
        centroizi = [[sum(c) / len(g) for c in zip(*g)] if g else centroizi[i] for i, g in enumerate(grupuri)]
    eticheta = [min(range(len(centroizi)), key=lambda i: dist(p, centroizi[i])) for p in puncte]
    return eticheta, centroizi

X = [[1, 1], [1, 2], [9, 9], [10, 10]]
